---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or a change to how femto works.
---

Please search for duplicate or closed issues first.

## Describe the feature

### Problem
A concise description of what you are trying to do and what gets in the way.

### Proposed Solution
A concise description of what you would like femto to do, such as the HTML you would write and how it should look.

### Alternatives Considered
Other approaches you have tried, such as your own CSS.
